name: Midea
verdict: Owned by Midea Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE 000333, HKEX 0300), controlled by founder He Xiangjian via Midea Holding (28.33%, non-state-owned). No state or fund shareholder of 5% or more. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Midea Group's 2024 annual report classifies its controlling shareholder Midea Holding Co., Ltd. as a 'Domestic non-state-owned corporation'; the largest state-linked holders (China Securities Finance 2.59%, Central Huijin 1.15%) are below the 5% link threshold, so no state link claimable.
